description: Use this to answer 'why was that order held?' or 'what policy version decided that price change?' by reading the signed Decision Dossier for a known dossier UUID within the environment-bound organization. This is a tenant read; it never executes or modifies a commerce action and it fails closed when credentials are absent or invalid.

dossier_id.description: UUID returned by commercegate_evaluate_action or a shadow report.

name: commercegate_get_dossier
title: Get a CommerceGate Decision Dossier
